name: Pillar 3a (CHF 150,000) and a BVG lump sum (CHF 500,000) in the same year, Zurich
workings: All of a year's capital benefits are taxed together: 650,000.
Zurich: 1/20 = 32,500; simple tax 564 + 5% × 7,700 = 949, a rate of 2.92%; simple 18,980.00; cantonal 18,031.00, communal 22,586.20.
Total 55,077.888; in separate years 7,835.128 + 35,067.888 = 42,903.016, so taking the 3a in an earlier year saves 12,174.872.
